scope: Offline audit of exact main timing cohort; no runtime action or causal hardware inference.
selection: Exact intersection of completed, explicitly unprofiled, timing-eligible IDs1–48; warmup0/final-save49 excluded.

field_mapping.microbatch_count: Native log Rollout-side DP schedule num_microbatches four-entry list. One schedule per training rollout, paired to the next rank0 training-side length log; all50 sequences verified in order.

cross_checks.schedule_association: Each schedule lies after the prior rank0 rollout-length event and before the current one, with IDs0–49 complete.

interpretation: GB300 has 0.309% more reported prompt+response tokens and 0.474% more scheduled microbatches across this cohort. Those aggregate differences are small relative to the 77.33% actor-time difference.
Descriptive seconds per reported token changes the ratio from1.77330 to1.76784. This does not isolate hardware or prove a linear causal token/time model.
limitations: Response tokens alone are generation length, not full actor sequence workload. The input-sequence proxy additionally includes prompts and agrees with the native actor throughput numerator.

The logged numerator is not directly measured padded kernel tokens, loss-mask effective tokens, FLOPs, recomputation work, expert routing, per-rank shape distribution or sum of squared sequence lengths. These quantities are not retained for the main cohort.
Microbatch counts are the logged rollout-side schedule, not an independent trace of every executed CUDA operation or per-rank packing.
Aggregate length differences are small, but per-ID total length ratios vary from0.9301 to1.1790. Shape, padding and routing differences may still affect cost.
Equal prompt token counts do not prove bitwise equality of prompt contents. New shared frozen-batch diagnostics provide a different, stronger input-control scope.
Actor stage covers four updates per rollout. This audit must not be presented as a single-microbatch trace measurement or explain the entire main ratio from one profiled rank.
